invariants.rule: A stage may run only when every earlier stage is approved with an approved_artifact_id. S1 has no predecessor.
Each project has at most one queued/running Job. Any other mutation while active returns PROJECT_BUSY. Reads and browser navigation remain available.
Generation succeeds into a new unapproved ArtifactVersion. It never approves itself.
Edit creates a new version and edit Decision; old rows are not overwritten. S1 results_conclusion remains null. Evidence/input_snapshot are not client-editable.

Approve requires current Artifact, needs_review, valid payload, current input refs, no active Job, and current_artifact_id different from approved_artifact_id. Stage approved pointer changes atomically with Decision and downstream staleness.
New approval stales every later stage with an existing artifact; empty later stages stay pending. Preserve all old artifacts/approval pointers as historical data.
Only S1 approval changes Project.current_brief_artifact_id. S2-S6 do not write Brief or accept a brief_delta.
Back records a Decision and returns n-1 navigation. It does not mutate state or invalidate artifacts. Reject S1 back.
request_id is generated by client once per intended action and deduplicated server-side. Same payload returns same result; same ID with another payload returns REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT.
Run context is snapshotted before enqueue in the same short DB transaction; worker loads those immutable artifact IDs, never rereads current pointers to build its prompt.
Stage 5 requires a stored Run belonging to the project and an experiment_id in the currently approved S3 plan. Required metric_names from that experiment must be present.
All active jobs at application startup become interrupted and their stages needs_review. Retain existing artifacts; never silently rerun a billable call.
Live failures never use fixture outputs. Demo/live is immutable per Project; environment APP_MODE only selects mode for newly created Projects.
A stale artifact is read-only and cannot be edited or approved. Regenerate after upstream approvals. A failed job with no current artifact is retried through initial run.

For S3, every approved Brief hypothesis must occur in at least one experiment, with no duplicate hypothesis ID within an experiment, and body_md must contain an Ablation plan or a reason it is not applicable. For S5, verdicts must contain every Brief hypothesis exactly once; hypotheses outside the selected Run experiment must remain inconclusive with an untested reason. Apply semantic validation on generation, edit and approval.
